summary: MERGENT Phase 0 backend — formal testing agent iteration 2. 17/17 baseline pytest tests PASS (iteration 1 regression set). 12/12 NEW scenario tests PASS covering: unknown-run 404, /api/admin/orchestration/_debug shape, WS late-subscriber replay+run_already_finished, invalid+valid payload isolation (5 bad/5 valid interleaved), 5-way concurrent stability with run_id isolation, WS ordering & cross-run isolation, TextileFlow ERP top-3 consistency across 5 sequential canonical runs (top-3 SET overlap >=2/3 across all 10 pairs), ranking determinism (top-5 SET stable across repeats), trace integrity (WS unique (agent,status) pairs == trace.steps pairs in order), ContextCompression keyword path (agent runs cleanly), Ranking p95 latency = 8.43s (distribution [5989, 6476, 6183, 7926, 8430, 6761, 6633, 7099, 7858, 8728] ms, target <30s) , WS channel cleanup returns to baseline after disconnect. ONE FINDING: ContextCompression compressed=True branch is unreachable via the public API because COMPRESS_TOKEN_THRESHOLD=6000 tokens vs the 8000-char (~2000 token) input cap — code path otherwise correct.

minor.issue: Returns 503 'queue_unavailable' when celery broker connection fails (Connection refused observed during one window). Acceptable per spec; endpoint logic correct.

compressed=True branch is unreachable through the public surface: COMPRESS_TOKEN_THRESHOLD=6000 tokens (compression.py L15) but POST /api/match caps requirement_text at 8000 chars (~2000 tokens). With 10 seeded candidates, full estimated token count tops out around ~4800 tokens. Recommend either lowering the threshold (e.g. 4000 tokens) OR raising the requirement_text cap OR documenting that compression only triggers once the solution catalog grows.

action_items: Decide on ContextCompression threshold vs input cap mismatch — current code never triggers compression for any payload that can pass /api/match validation. Either lower COMPRESS_TOKEN_THRESHOLD or raise requirement_text 8000-char limit, otherwise this Phase 0 capability is effectively dead code.
critical_code_review_comments: WSManager.cleanup is correctly called on disconnect and channels DO drop back to baseline after subscribers detach (scenario #10 verified end-to-end: 5 runs x 4 sockets = 20 connections opened+closed, ws.total_channels returned to baseline).

WebSocket isolation: events for run A never appear on run B's channel (verified by collecting events from 5 concurrent runs and 2 sequential WS-subscribed runs — every event with a run_id carried its OWN run_id).
Trace and WS event ordering are consistent: unique (agent, status) pair sequence on WS matches trace.steps order exactly; started_at is monotonically non-decreasing on the persisted trace.
Ranking is deterministic: top-5 SETs identical across repeated canonical runs (temperature=0 honored).
TextileFlow ERP (1923bfa7-...) appears in top 3 in 5/5 canonical runs; top-3 SET pairwise overlap >= 2 across all 10 pairs.
Validation contract is strong: empty/whitespace/<5/>8000 all map to structured 400 errors; non-string/non-JSON map to 422; concurrent valid runs are unaffected by interleaved bad requests.
Latency well within spec: Ranking p95 = 8.43s across 10 runs, far below the 30s gate; full pipeline e2e runs ~7-13s observed.
DESIGN ISSUE (non-blocking): ContextCompression threshold is unreachable through validated input — see backend_issues.minor[1] and action_items.

rca_of_the_issue: ContextCompression compressed=True unreachable: compression.py uses COMPRESS_TOKEN_THRESHOLD=6000 tokens against full context (user_text + parsed_requirement + concatenated candidate {title, tagline, description, tech_stack, tags}). With 10 seeded candidates the candidate-side contribution is ~2800 tokens; the input cap of 8000 chars (~2000 tokens) means total never exceeds ~4800 tokens. Mitigation: lower threshold to ~4000 tokens OR raise requirement_text cap OR grow the catalog so candidate-side context dominates. This is NOT a runtime bug — the gate is correctly evaluated and the agent always emits a structured step with compressed flag and token estimate — but it makes the compression capability untestable end-to-end with the current public contract.
